पत् (ऌ) पतति 1.
a. (क) पतयति,
पातयति 10.
a. To go, to move;
to fall; to be superhuman. (य, ङ)
पत्यते 4.
d. To be rich. With अति
prefixed, to excel; with अभि^1 or अव
to descend; with आ^2 to arrive; with उत्^3 to
ascend; with नि^4 to gain; with निर्^5 to ab-
scond; with परि^6 to go fast, be valu-
able; with सं^7 to go with, to gain; with प्र^8
and with नि^9 to fall prostrate; with वि^10 and
with निर्^11 to turn back; with सं^12 and with आ^13 to
purify; with सं^14 and with उत्^15 to fly; with सं^16 and
with नि^17 to go out.
